events.title: Isaias strengthens to become first Atlantic hurricane of 2026 season
events.description: Storm expected to make landfall on US’s northern Gulf coast with risk of flash floods and isolated river flooding Isaias has become the first Atlantic hurricane of the 2026 season, with wind speeds of 80mph and a minimum pressure of 975mb. It is expected to strengthen to a category 2 hurricane as it approaches the US’s northern Gulf coast on Friday, according to the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA). As a result of the strong El Niño , it has been a notably quiet Atlantic hurricane season. The first hurricane of the season has not formed this late since 8 October 1905, which pre-dates the satellite era (1960s) for tracking hurricanes that has allowed for more non-landfall hurricanes to be discovered. events.description: DNA left on a protective painting cover helped investigators recover two stolen Renoirs and uncover what they suspected were preparations for another art heist, a French prosecutor said Monday.

events.title: Many Iranians who go to Turkey to find jobs are exploited
events.description: Desperate Iranians are finding work in Turkey to make ends meet, but many are being exploited and left with nothing but more debt.

events.title: Both Russia and Ukraine are using AI-powered drones on the battlefield
events.description: A Ukrainian company that got rich making smartphone-controlled cameras to watch pets at home now outfits first-person-view drones with an image recognition system powered by artificial intelligence.

events.title: Cornell suspends frat parties after gang rape case
events.description: Cornell said no parties will be held at frat houses until the end of the academic year. The university is trying to mend its reputation following its handling of a gang rape case in 2024.

events.title: Tupac Shakur murder trial: Former gang leader Duane Davis sentenced to 40 years
events.description: Former Los Angeles gang leader Duane "Keffe D" Davis was found guilty of ordering the killing of hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur.

events.title: Germany news: Left-leaning Berlin coalition talks break down
events.description: The SPD and Greens in Berlin have halted exploratory coalition talks with the Left Party amid a dispute over Israel policy and antisemitism. DW has more.

events.title: Ukraine and the US: What's next after Trump's diesel deal with Russia?
events.description: Donald Trump plans to allow the purchase of Russian diesel, drawing criticism at home and abroad. What is behind the US president's decision and what should Ukraine do next? DW spoke with experts.

events.title: Hungary's parliament votes to reverse anti-LGBTQ legislation from Orban era
events.description: Hungary's parliament passed a bill amending the 2021 "child protection law." The move is considered the first significant reversal of Orban's curbs targeting the LGBTQ+ community.

events.title: Champions League: Arsenal leave no chance to Lille and Olivier Giroud
events.description: Lille suffered a heavy defeat at Arsenal (3-0) in Champions League Matchday 2. Olivier Giroud faced Arsenal, his former club.

events.title: What we know about Pope Leo XIV's lung cancer diagnosis
events.description: Pope Leo underwent surgery on Tuesday to remove a cancerours tumour from his right lung after saying that a nodule had been "detected at a very early stage". Following a "successful" operation, the Vatican said the pontiff would undergo additional testing.

events.title: Arsenal thrash Lille as Atletico Madrid beat Manchester United
events.description: Arsenal scored three goals in seven second-half minutes on Tuesday to beat Lille 3-0 and maintain their perfect Champions League start, while Atletico Madrid defeated Manchester United 2-0 to deepen the pressure on Michael Carrick. Bayern Munich were held to a shock 3-3 draw by Norway’s Viking after Michael Olise was sent off.

events.title: 🔴 Surgery on Pope Leo's cancerous lung nodule went well, Vatican says
events.description: No description available.

events.title: Kabila launches new coalition with M23
events.description: In tonight's edition, Joseph Kabila has been named leader of a new rebel coalition, vowing to topple the government. Also, Africa's largest ever IPO has been extended. And Formula ⁠1 ⁠will return to ⁠Africa in ​the early 2030s, once a new circuit is built in Rwanda.

events.title: Cancer found after Pope had part of his lung removed during 'successful' surgery
events.description: The Pope has undergone surgery to treat lung cancer.

events.title: Formula One to return to Africa for first time in 30 years
events.description: Formula One is set to return to Africa for the first time in more than three decades after Rwanda signed a 10-year deal to host the race.

events.title: Prosecutors drop 3 impeachment charges against Philippine VP to speed up trial
events.description: Philippine prosecutors have dropped three of four impeachment charges against Vice President Sara Duterte to speed up her ongoing trial

events.title: 20 green sea turtles returned to the ocean after Bali smuggling raid
events.description: Indonesian authorities on the tourist island of Bali have released 20 protected green sea turtles back into the ocean Tuesday

events.title: Great Wolf Lodge horror as mom accused of killing husband and toddler inside hotel room
events.description: Metallica Rose Harrison allegedly stabbed her husband and toddler at a Great Wolf Lodge in Pennsylvania before telling responders about her "happy family."

events.title: Former Chicago police detective linked by DNA to 8-year-old girl's cold-case murder, police say
events.description: DNA evidence and a fingerprint linked Thomas F. McInerney Jr., a former Chicago police detective, to the 1960 cold case murder of Gloria Kowalewicz.

events.title: Embattled Soros-backed DA blames ‘criminal’ police misconduct in accused Philly cop killer’s prior murder case
events.description: Eric Lewis was acquitted of murder in 2019 after what DA Larry Krasner says was police misconduct that deeply undermined the earlier homicide case.

events.title: Illegal suspect in NYPD detective stabbing denies involvement after extradition from Massachusetts
events.description: NYPD Detective Jose Mercedes speaks out after two illegal immigrants from the Dominican Republic allegedly stabbed him seven times in the Bronx.

events.title: Mom accused of driving car off cliff with young kids inside, faces DUI, child neglect charges
events.description: Chase Ryan Klinedinst allegedly drove off a Chattanooga cliff with two children inside, landing upside down near railroad tracks, police say.

events.title: 911 operators questioned whether Christa Pike failed execution call was prank, audio reveals
events.description: 911 audio reveals dispatchers initially dismissed Christa Pike's failed execution as a prank call, delaying the ambulance response to Riverbend Prison.

events.title: FBI operation targets scam compounds in Africa with arrests, account takedowns
events.description: Operation Blackout's latest raids across Ghana and Nigeria netted 28 arrests, freed trafficked workers and saw Meta remove 3.7 million accounts.

events.title: Trump's new press secretary takes the podium after weeks-long White House shake-up and more top headlines
events.description: Get all the stories you need-to-know from the most powerful name in news delivered first thing every morning to your inbox.

events.title: Feds arrest man on Nantucket in early morning operation involving multiple felony charges
events.description: Rigoberto Chavez-Regaldo faces child trafficking and aggravated rape charges after a multi-agency arrest operation on Nantucket, Massachusetts.

events.title: US military archbishop urges Catholic soldiers to refuse involvement in Army firing squad execution
events.description: Archbishop Timothy Broglio urged Catholic soldiers to refuse firing squad duty in the planned execution of Nidal Hasan, calling the livestream barbaric.

events.title: Man admits to dismembering ex-girlfriend, keeping severed head in suitcase after she played him 'like a fool'
events.description: A New York man pleaded guilty to second-degree murder after he admitted that he murdered and dismembered his ex-girlfriend and kept her severed head in a suitcase.

events.title: Pope Leo diagnosed with lung cancer after surgeons remove part of right lung, Vatican says
events.description: Pope Leo XIV arrived at Gemelli Hospital in Rome for lung nodule removal after doctors said the growth was identified at a "very early stage." Doctors later confirmed he had a form of lung cancer.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Pope Leo diagnosed with lung cancer after surgeons remove part of right lung, Vatican says

events.title: Abbas delays Palestinian elections again, making more than two decades without vote
events.description: Palestinian Authority President Mahmoud Abbas delayed elections to 2027, extending a nearly 20-year wait as Israel and Hamas clash over the blame.

events.title: Pope Leo announces tumor on lung, surgery planned in 'next few days'
events.description: Pope Leo XIV announced doctors found a lung nodule at a "very early stage," with surgery scheduled in coming days.
